newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian c.bank reserves fall in November.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian c.bank reserves fall in November.

text.p: Official reserves at Lithuania's central bank fell in November to $804.1 million from $842.8 million in October, the bank said on Thursday.
The bank said in a statement that foreign currency reserves also fell in November to $727 million from $764.4 million.
The bank's reserves were highest in August at $852.5 million after recovering from a bank crisis at the start of the year, which caused a run on the litas currency.
The litas also suffered in late October after Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said he wanted to unpeg the litas from the dollar at the beginning of 1997.
Vagnorius has since said he sees no big changes in the country's monetary regime until late next year.
Official reserves at the start of 1996 were $819 million, the central bank added.
The central bank said it had $62 million of gold in its vaults, unchanged from the start of the year.
